_comment: Country risk lists used by the corridor engine. FATF publishes these three times a year (February, June, October plenaries) and has no machine-readable feed: update by hand from fatf-gafi.org and record the plenary date. EU list: Commission Delegated Regulation on high-risk third countries; update from eur-lex. Verify before each pilot.

fatf_call_for_action.source: FATF, High-Risk Jurisdictions subject to a Call for Action

fatf_increased_monitoring.source: FATF, Jurisdictions under Increased Monitoring (the 'grey list'); VERIFY against the latest plenary statement before use

eu_high_risk_third_countries.source: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2016/1675 as amended; populate from the current annex
